title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.17 (po:4500013023-10) through EUR 5.24 (po:4500013392-10), EUR 5.43 (po:4500013795-10) to EUR 5.45 (po:4500014455-10) between 2025-10-06 and 2026-09-24. That rise is already in our price.

Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 says that your nickel and alloys requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027.

We attach two clause-free packages for 94800 kg per year over 24 months. This gives you a full two-year base load and reduces your sales effort.

As your owner offered in our call (doc:20260421-70710-M2), could you walk us through your material and conversion calculation? Which variants would lower the price for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - price basis from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We welcome the opportunity for a 24-month agreement, which allows us to reduce the unit price to EUR 5.36. Because this term extends beyond our current fixed-price coverage ending in March 2027, we must include the AS-14404 index clause. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our specialists will gladly follow up with you regarding the cost breakdown and potential technical variants.

Our offer provides a price of €5.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.36 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: part:370010 - revised clause-free package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and for the variant information.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We attach a revised clause-free package for 94800 kg per year over 24 months, at 90 days payment. A fixed price keeps your administration simple and gives you a two-year base load. We would rather not take on an index clause.

We will review the grade and tolerance variants with our engineering team. Could you tell us which lot sizes and call-off patterns would ease your workload most?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: part:370010 - revised clause-free package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.12 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Because our fixed-price coverage ends in March 2027, we must maintain the AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month contract. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.24 per unit.

Regarding your question, call-offs in minimum lots of 5,000 kg with a steady monthly pattern would optimize our production and logistics. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.24 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.05 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.03 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your revised offer and the call-off guidance.

On volume: we commit to 94800 kg per year over 24 months. That is 7900 kg per month in a steady monthly pattern, which is above your 5,000 kg minimum lot.

We have moved our clause-free package a clear step towards you, keeping 90 days payment and 24 months. Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 notes that your alloy requirement is fixed until March 2027, so a fixed price matches your own cover for the first period. It also spares both sides the monthly surcharge administration.

Could you sign this package, or tell us which call-off pattern would let you meet it?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part:370010 - revised fixed-price package, 24 months
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. 

We have moved our price in response to your volume commitment and ask you to accept the index clause for the duration of the agreement. However, as our fixed-price coverage for alloys ends in March 2027, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month contract and must maintain the AS-14404 index clause.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can offer a price of €5.07 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.19 per unit, alongside Zahlungsziel 90 days net and a contract term of 24 months.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.
